subject: Sidebar text conditional on which tab is open

messages.author: b3dc6020e46339d5
messages.subject: Sidebar text conditional on which tab is open
parts:
I have a tabset panel as the main panel in the shiny UI, and I'm trying to get different help text to appear in the sidebar panel depending on which tab the user has open. I tried doing some stuff with conditional panels and whatnot, but couldn't get anything to work. Any suggestions?


Thanks,

Josh

messages.author: 782ed6ec348dba9b
messages.subject: Re: Sidebar text conditional on which tab is open
parts:
Try this

ui.R

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
   
  headerPanel(""),
  
   sidebarPanel(
    uiOutput("helpText")
  
    ),
  
 mainPanel(
  tabsetPanel(
   
    tabPanel("1",value=1), 
    tabPanel("2", value=2),
    id="tabs1")
 
  )
))


server.R
shinyServer(function(input, output) {

  output$helpText <- renderUI( {
   
    if (input$tabs1==1) {
      helpText("you are on tab 1")
     
    } else if (input$tabs1==2) {
      helpText("you are now on tab 2")
    }
    })
 
  })
